title: baio builder output — shapes wave 3 (containment; 22-op vocabulary)
description: The wave-3 (containment) builder OUTPUT contract. Byte-identical in shape and op enum (22) to shapes-v2.json — wave 3 changes the INPUT side only: builder-input detections gain a normalizer-assigned `parent: <detection_id> | null` field (shared/schemas/README.md §1.6), and the 1:1 rule becomes one command per TOP-LEVEL (parent=null) detection — child detections route into their parent's command params (label, fill, gradient, glyph-op selection) and emit no commands of their own. That top-level-only rule is a domain-validator check, not expressible in this grammar. This file exists so wave-3 training/serving configs ([train] structured_outputs, per-request response_format) can reference the wave unambiguously. schema_version stays the literal "shapes-1.0": contract revision, not wave. The model still emits NO coordinates: geometry always derives deterministically from the source strokes. See shared/schemas/README.md.
